opening.argument: The video shows an ordinary rewards workflow: viewers are shown how to create an account, claim daily rewards, watch ads, and enter a Litecoin amount and wallet address for withdrawal. Referrals are promoted as another way to earn, and the description directs viewers to platform links. The deposit function is visible, but it is not presented as a condition for claiming rewards or withdrawing; the description instead says viewers can earn without spending their own money. This is promotional content, but the cited material does not establish a deceptive demand for payment or misleading use of viewers' account data.
